Which of the following CAN be implied if the given statement is true?
Statement: A 5-digit number is formed using single-digit whole numbers such that the units digit is even and all the remaining digits are odd.
a) The number definitely lies between 11111 and 99999
b) The number formed CAN be a multiple of 100
c) The sum of the digits of the largest such number is 44
d) The sum of the digits is NOT divisible by 2
My answer
Dyna Thinking Coach
Echo
say it in your own words
Say the rule in your own words: "the last digit is even, and every other digit is odd." Then read each option as a claim to test.
Slicer
break it into small parts
Test the options one at a time. For each one, try to build a number that follows the rule but breaks the claim. If you can, the claim is false.
YOUR TURN
Which claim could you not break?
2
Rohan revealed his 5-digit phone password in a code word to Rajesh where all the digits are NATURAL NUMBERS. Which of the following statements are SUFFICIENT to crack the code?
Statement 1: One of these digits is 1, and 2 appears thrice in the password
Statement 2: The first digit is smaller than all other digits and the 2nd digit is smaller than the 3rd
Statement 3: The largest digit in the password is 3 and it appears only once
a) Statements 1 and 2
b) Statements 2 and 3
c) All the statements are required
d) Cannot be determined even after using all the statements
My answer
Dyna Thinking Coach
Starter
decide how to begin
Begin with Statement 3: the largest digit is 3. So which digits can the password use at all?
Slicer
break it into small parts
Add one statement at a time. After each one, write what you know about every place: 1st, 2nd, 3rd, 4th and 5th. Stop when only one password fits.
YOUR TURN
Which statements did you actually need?
